selection_rule: Select smallest initial-period primary MAE; numerical ties within 1e-12 prefer baseline then local28, local182, local364, shared, seasonal. Retain baseline unless that same initial winner reduces MAE >=5% versus baseline in BOTH development periods. Do not promote another candidate from diagnostics. This 5% is a supplied engineering stability rule, not commercial value or externally declared success threshold.
horizon_mismatch: Selection on seven-day recorded units; orders cover supplied lead+review days. Secondary coverage results do not choose model.
